name: G8 T3 W04 - Binary numbers
description: Study these five words across this week. Complete Flashcards, Matching and Fill in Blank once. Then choose additional practice. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: A single binary digit, either zero or one.
words.example: One bit can store either 0 or 1.

words.definition: A number system that uses only the digits zero and one.
The base-ten number system, which uses the digits zero to nine.
words.example: The decimal number five is written as 101 in binary.

words.definition: One symbol used to write a number.
words.example: Each digit in 101 is either zero or one.

words.definition: The value a digit has because of its position in a number.
words.example: The leftmost place value in four-bit binary is eight.
